design_philosophy: Gen Z focused neo-brutalism. High-contrast color blocks with stark, raw surfaces, chunky typography, and visible black borders. Overlaps with modern mobile ergonomics like thumb-friendly layouts, tactile haptics, and layered depth.

typography.font_pairings: Outfit for all Headings (H1-H4) and large numbers. Figtree for body copy and UI labels.

spacing_and_layout.general: Mobile-first approach (max-w-md mx-auto for desktop view). Generous padding inside containers (p-6). Elements should have breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Use border-2 or border-[3px] border-black for all interactive elements and cards.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Neo-brutalist hard shadows: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]. Active state: translate-y-[4px] translate-x-[4px] shadow-[0px_0px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)].
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-xl or rounded-2xl for a friendly touch contrasting with the hard borders.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento-style grids on dashboard. Mix large and small squares.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFE885] border-2 border-black text-black font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:bg-[#FFD1C1] active:translate-y-1 active:translate-x-1 active:shadow-[0px_0px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-black text-black font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:bg-[#E2D5F8] active:translate-y-1 active:translate-x-1 active:shadow-[0px_0px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all

components.cards: bg-white border-[3px] border-black rounded-2xl shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] p-6. Overflow hidden for internal images.
components.inputs: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-xl p-4 text-base focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#C4F1DE] focus:border-black transition-all
components.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-2xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] flex justify-around p-3 z-50
components.tags: bg-[#C4F1DE] border-2 border-black rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider

animations.micro_interactions: Use Framer Motion for tap states (scale: 0.95). Spring physics for opening bottom sheets.
animations.flashcards: 3D flip animation using Framer Motion (rotateY). Maintain hard border on both sides.
animations.page_transitions: Slide up from bottom with slight fade in.

home_dashboard.header: Welcome message with mascot image on the right. Large H1 greeting.
home_dashboard.exam_countdown: Horizontal scroll of cards featuring hourglass_3d image. Vibrant bg colors (mint, peach) per card. Big bold countdown numbers.
home_dashboard.quick_actions: Bento grid (2 columns). Explain (lavender), Summarize (yellow), Quiz (mint), Flashcards (peach). Big icons, chunky text.

explain_concept.layout: Chat-style interface or stacked cards. Bottom fixed area for typing/uploading photo.
explain_concept.ai_response: Rendered in a card with background_texture as a subtle background. Highlight key terms with yellow background and black text.

summarize_content.upload_zone: Large dashed border-[3px] border-black rounded-2xl bg-[#E2D5F8]/50 p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center.
summarize_content.output: Accordion-style summary points to keep content scannable on mobile.

quiz.question_card: Massive card at the top, highly legible.
quiz.answers: Stack of 4 chunky buttons. On select, change bg to green (correct) or red (incorrect) with heavy black borders.

flashcards.layout: Swipeable stack (Tinder-style) or single massive card in center.
flashcards.flip: Tap to flip. Front: Concept. Back: Definition + mnemonic.

assets.icons_library: lucide-react with strokeWidth={2.5} or {3} to match neo-brutalism.

images.description: Neo-brutalist floating brain over books. Use in onboarding or home dashboard header.
Mint abstract brutalist background. Use as card background for AI explanations or hero section.
3D hourglass. Use in the Exam Countdown widgets/cards.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to high contrast. Black text on pastel backgrounds passes WCAG effortlessly.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements. Buttons are padded heavily.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for flashcard flips and page transitions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a mobile-first web app using React, Tailwind, and Shadcn components, prioritizing small screen layouts (max-w-md mx-auto).
Apply neo-brutalist styling globally: use 'border-2 border-black' or 'border-[3px] border-black' and hard shadows 'shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]' on cards and buttons.
Never use generic light-gray borders or soft drop shadows.
Implement the bottom navigation bar fixed at the bottom with high contrast.
For inputs, include a camera icon to signify the OCR/Photo upload feature.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='quiz-option-a').
Ensure the layout doesn't require a login screen. The initial route should be the Home Dashboard.
Use Framer Motion for tap states (scale: 0.95) and flashcard flips.
Use the provided image URLs strictly for their designated categories.
